en.summary: Fixes modeled FPU conversion-flag routing so float-to-float conversions use their own exception-flag source and are not dropped from the final fflags mux.
why_it_counts: The patch changes architecturally visible FPU status behavior in the modeled execution unit.
It fixes the exception-flag path for one concrete conversion subtype rather than changing tests or host code.
The result path was already present; the commit corrects only the semantic bookkeeping for IEEE flags.
evidence: A dedicated fflags_f2f array is added next to the other FCVT flag arrays.
dpi_f2f is changed from writing fflags_ftou[i] to writing fflags_f2f[i].
The final fflags_fcvt mux gains an is_f2f case so f2f flags are returned architecturally.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A floating-point conversion unit must route exception flags from the specific conversion operator that produced the result. If float-to-float conversions reuse another conversion's flag channel, or if their flags are omitted from the final per-op mux, the numeric result can be correct while architectural fflags becomes wrong.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Any float-to-float format conversion that can raise inexact, overflow, underflow, or invalid flags.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Misroute float-to-float exception flags onto another conversion subtype's flag path, or suppress the float-to-float select case in the final flag-return mux.
portability_notes: Apply this where multiple FP conversion subtypes share a common result/flag selection block.
The bug is about status-flag provenance, not data-result selection.
Any DUT with architectural IEEE flag reporting can reproduce this by aliasing one conversion subtype's flags onto another.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that collects exception flags for integer-to-float, float-to-integer, float-to-unsigned, and float-to-float conversions.
Make the float-to-float path write or select the same flag storage used by another conversion subtype instead of its own dedicated storage.
If the design has a final conversion-result mux and a separate flag mux, leave the data mux intact and corrupt only the flag mux.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_fpu_dpi FCVT per-lane result and fflags selection
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds fflags_f2f, connects dpi_f2f to that flag array, and adds an is_f2f arm to fflags_fcvt.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the FCVT block around dpi_f2f and fflags_fcvt, route dpi_f2f back to fflags_ftou and remove the is_f2f selection from the final flag mux.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Float-to-float conversion instructions produce correct or mostly correct data but report wrong or missing IEEE exception flags.
evidence_for_injection: Before the fix, dpi_f2f wrote into the fflags_ftou storage.
Before the fix, fflags_fcvt had no is_f2f case and therefore dropped f2f flags.
The commit does not change the conversion result mux semantics beyond preserving existing f2f result selection.
notes: This is a modeled-hardware semantics bug, so failures may appear only in architectural status flags.
A minimal reverse mutation can target only the flag path and leave data results untouched.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了建模 FPU 转换异常标志的路由问题，使 float-to-float 转换使用独立的异常标志来源，并且不会在最终 fflags 选择中被丢掉。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了建模执行单元中体系结构可见的 FPU 状态行为。
它修复的是一个具体转换子类型的异常标志路径，而不是测试或主机端代码。
结果数据路径原本就存在；该提交修正的是 IEEE 标志的语义记账。
evidence: 补丁在其他 FCVT 标志数组旁边新增了专用的 fflags_f2f 数组。
dpi_f2f 从写入 fflags_ftou[i] 改为写入 fflags_f2f[i]。
最终的 fflags_fcvt 多路选择新增了 is_f2f 分支，因此 f2f 标志会在体系结构上被返回。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 浮点转换单元必须从实际产生结果的那个转换算子获取异常标志。如果 float-to-float 转换复用了其他转换的标志通道，或者其标志在最终多路选择中被遗漏，那么数值结果可能是对的，但体系结构可见的 fflags 会出错。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 按操作类型区分的浮点异常标志路由
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 任意可能产生 inexact、overflow、underflow 或 invalid 标志的 float-to-float 格式转换。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把 float-to-float 的异常标志错误地接到另一种转换子类型的标志路径上，或者在最终返回标志的多路选择中去掉 float-to-float 分支。
portability_notes: 应在多个浮点转换子类型共用结果/标志选择逻辑的位置注入该缺陷。
该缺陷针对的是状态标志来源，而不是数据结果选择。
任何会对外暴露 IEEE 标志的 DUT，都可以通过让一种转换子类型复用另一种的标志路径来复现。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位收集 int-to-float、float-to-int、float-to-unsigned、float-to-float 等转换异常标志的逻辑。
让 float-to-float 路径写入或选择另一种转换子类型使用的标志存储，而不是自己的专用存储。
如果设计中数据结果多路选择和标志多路选择是分开的，保留数据多路选择不变，只破坏标志多路选择。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_fpu_dpi 中 FCVT 的逐 lane 结果与 fflags 选择逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复增加了 fflags_f2f，让 dpi_f2f 写入该数组，并在 fflags_fcvt 中增加 is_f2f 分支。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 FCVT 代码块中 dpi_f2f 和 fflags_fcvt 附近，把 dpi_f2f 改回写入 fflags_ftou，并从最终标志多路选择中移除 is_f2f 分支。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: float-to-float 转换指令会产生正确或基本正确的数据结果，但报告错误或缺失的 IEEE 异常标志。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前，dpi_f2f 会把结果写到 fflags_ftou 存储中。
修复前，fflags_fcvt 没有 is_f2f 分支，因此会丢掉 f2f 标志。
该提交没有改变转换结果多路选择的核心语义，主要修的是标志路径。
notes: 这是建模硬件语义缺陷，因此失败现象可能只体现在体系结构状态标志上。
最小反向注入只需要修改标志路径，不必改动数据结果路径。
